description: This Java class defines a criteria object for searching or filtering MedicationDispense records in the OpenMRS healthcare system. It encapsulates search parameters such as patient, encounter, drug order, and whether to include voided records. The class serves as a data holder with getter and setter methods and is associated with a builder class for convenient instantiation.

classes.name: MedicationDispenseCriteria
classes.description: A criteria object for filtering medication dispense records based on patient, encounter, drug order, and inclusion of voided records.
